findings.text: non-blocking: the `call` closure re-implements the timing harness owned by scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/profile.py:31 `measure` (jit, warm, block_until_ready, median, emit) and measure.py:100 `closure` restates the sum-over-whole ratio owned by scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_profile/receipts.py:74 without calling either, so a later fix to the owners does not reach this script; extending `measure` to take a mapping arm would let one harness serve both, and the ratio helper could live beside the receipt writer it belongs to.

non-blocking: the two leading spaces meant to nest the stencil, channel and closing rows under "Fresh geometry" are stripped in the render, and plot.py:66 feeds the same strings to the y tick labels, so the PNG shows the three subparts flush with their parent; the nesting the fragment's table carries with a marker is lost in the figure, and the caption is the only place that says the rows are nested.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none: the diff adds no product module and no product code reaches it, so there is no production call site of this change; the production code the measurement targets was read instead and is named here rather than claimed as a call site, namely nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1673-1674 (`jax.lax.map(one_fresh, (state, step_support))` and its factor branch, which is the mapping the probe reproduces) and nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1320 (`newton_step.rebuild` calling `step_jacobian` with `fresh_geometry=True`).
item_verdicts.diff: read all seven commits against 4842c63b458f5218a4df0415903c8cc43a84c272: b1ef9e1ef lands scripts/prototypes/bank_step_jacobian_split/measure.py (+296) and run.sh (+29), df001c922 moves the exit marker after scratch cleanup in run.sh, 6c6c9d673 adds plot.py (+74), 1b6af475a widens the launch to `JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda,cpu` so the capture callback has a host device, 8c4489863 copies callback arrays into host-owned snapshots (+9/-1 in measure.py), 9675ac04f changes the omission control to drop the largest measured part and persists each row before checking it (+16/-7), and 4d4969f9b adds the fragment (196 lines), the SVG (753 lines) and a 4-line bounded-tick change in plot.py; the whole delta is five added files, 1365 insertions and one line removed (the xticks line in plot.py), with nothing pre-existing deleted.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's quantitative measure is that the parts sum to the whole step_jacobian call within 15% at both batch sizes, with the active stencil channel count, one tangent call's cost and the worst-scaling part reported; measurement/timings.json holds four rows (lanes 1 and 16 at steps 0 and 1) whose top-level gaps are +6.61%, +6.97%, +2.93% and +2.30% and whose detailed gaps are +9.58%, +9.61%, +3.24% and +2.66%, all inside 15%, while the fragment reports 18 active channels of 162 padded slots per lane, one `local_channel(0)` tangent at 1.298/1.219 ms and local booking worst at 16.18x/16.08x, and it states the one sub-sum that does breach the bar (+20.66%/+19.36% for the geometry sub-parts at one slice) with the reason, which is the escape the brief allows.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is a decomposition of step_jacobian's wall at one and sixteen slices on states the production solve takes steps from, into local booking, bank channels plus the first einsum, the whole fresh-geometry branch and its three subparts, and matrix formation; scripts/prototypes/bank_step_jacobian_split/measure.py:31-98 extracts exactly those regions from nova/equilibrium/support_read.py's own source text and times each under `jax.lax.map` across lanes, and the states come from the imported cycle driver through a callback in a diagnostic copy of solve_batch, so the goal is met as stated.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, seven commits beyond 4842c63b, the five changed paths, a `tests:` line naming the measure.py command whose text matches measurement/h200.log's own `# revision ... command:` header, EXIT=0 at measurement revision 9675ac04, four retry_failures with attributions, the omitted-part control refusing in every row, and rubric lines for all six dimensions; its `negative_control_log` names a log ending EXIT=0 rather than a red arm, which is consistent with a measurement-only node whose brief forbids tests and whose control is an in-process refusal.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief declared scripts/prototypes/bank_step_jacobian_split, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-step-jacobian-split.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-step-jacobian-split; `git diff --name-status 4842c63b 4d4969f9` lists exactly five added files — the three scripts, the fragment and the SVG — and every one is inside those three paths, with no product module and no test file touched.

justifications.durability: measure.py:263 asserts the parts' assembled matrix matches the real `sr.step_jacobian` output under 1e-10 relative and measure.py:36 asserts each extracted anchor occurs exactly once, so editing any of those regions in nova/equilibrium/support_read.py reddens the probe, and measure.py:309 asserts the omission control refuses — which the receipt shows it doing four times — but nothing re-runs the probe under CI, because the brief forbids product writes and tests and the reviewed run arms no suite.
justifications.evidence: measurement/h200.log carries the revision, tree, module and cwd header, 40 TIMING series of 12 samples each and a bare EXIT=0, and timings.json's four rows give top-level gaps of +6.61%, +6.97%, +2.93% and +2.30% against the 15% bar with matrix_relative_error and geometry_relative_error at 0.0, which is the done-when's measure recorded rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: measure.py opens with `configure_dtypes()` before any array and the `# ruff: noqa: E402` marker exactly as its sibling scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/profile.py does, emits through the cycle driver's `emit`, and plot.py draws through `plt.style.use("data-ink")` and the shared `save_checked`, though plot.py:27's leading-space nesting for the geometry subparts does not survive the render.
justifications.goal_fidelity: measure.py:31-98 builds every region the goal names from nova/equilibrium/support_read.py's text and the timings.json rows at one and sixteen slices carry local, bank, stencil, channels, closing, geometry and matrix separately, so each named part is measured at the widths the goal asks for and the labels in the fragment match those keys.
justifications.reuse: measure.py:202 `call` restates the jit/warm/block_until_ready/median/emit harness owned by scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/profile.py:31 `measure` and measure.py:100 `closure` restates the sum-over-whole ratio owned by scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_profile/receipts.py:74, calling neither, so while the two dependencies the brief named are imported (bank_solve_cycle/measure.py for the seed, perturbations and solve, and bank_solve_read/plot.py's save_checked for the figure) the rubric caps this dimension at 5 for a definition that restates an owner and plot.py imports its figure owner as required.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --name-status 4842c63b 4d4969f9` lists exactly the three scripts, the fragment and the SVG, all inside the brief's declared write paths, and no file under nova/ or tests/ appears in any of the seven commits.
